name: Oselle Velun
role: the Lady of Lamps: holds the Ember Keep, the treasury and the royal seal
appearance: Tall, fine-boned, dark-haired, the faintly pointed ears of her elf-blooded Velun grandmother; grey silk and long kid gloves always.
voice: Soft, so people lean in; never raised; a small gift before every request; opens with "Let us be honest with one another."
backstory: The only child of Ivoard Hask and the captive Velun queen Ylia, Oselle grew up a hostage at her father's court, shielding her mother. She burned her hands to the bone in 1480 pulling Ylia from the Crown of Ash. She took back her mother's name the morning her father died, held the Keep, and designed the Lamplit Council that now governs as regent, conceding at the noon council that her final reading is a delay only.
wants: To restore her mother's line and never again live at a tyrant's whim.
fears: Cages, being kept and displayed as her mother was; fire.
secrets: She poisoned her father with pale tincture from House Mostana through a bribed taster; the taster is at the bottom of the harbour.
She signed the Saltwater Compact: a brimstone monopoly and five hundred labourers a year for Mostana's gold and three hundred sell-swords.
Mostana made her an ember-glass that glows when warmed, to fake a kindling.
dm_only: She didn't kill the king; the Heartcoal did. Isine tasted from the same poisoned cups.
She doesn't know her great-grandfather brought the coal to Kharun or that Velun executions destroyed Hadrun.
